# allinkl_ddns_users (Data Source)

Reads all dynamic DNS logins of the KAS account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "allinkl_ddns_users" "all" {}

output "dynamic_hosts" {
  value = { for u in data.allinkl_ddns_users.all.users : u.host => u.current_ip }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Every dynamic DNS login of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Free text describing the login.
- `current_ip` (String) IPv4 address the host points at.
- `current_ipv6` (String) IPv6 address the host points at, in dual-stack mode.
- `dual_stack` (Boolean) Whether the host carries an A and an AAAA record.
- `host` (String) The host name the login controls.
- `label` (String) Host label inside the zone.
- `login` (String) KAS login, e.g. `dyn0123456`.
- `zone` (String) Zone of the host.
